name: Magistrate Henry Maleb
summary: In Southshore, Magistrate Henry Maleb keeps order in the Alliance's chief coastal stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills. The port town faces threats from the Forsaken and the Syndicate.

sections.title: Guardian of Southshore's Order
sections.body: Magistrate Henry Maleb governs from Southshore's town hall, one of the last true Alliance settlements in Lordaeron. Forsaken forces threaten the town from the north and west, while highwaymen prowl the foothills. Maleb took office after the previous magistrate was mysteriously assassinated, an act he blames on the Syndicate. He means to avoid the same fate. His investigations seek hidden assassins, Syndicate supply networks, and the nobles directing them from the ruins of Alterac.

sections.title: A Web of Noble Treachery
sections.body: The Syndicate's reach runs through the region. Assassins moving through the orchards outside Southshore are paid operatives taking contracts from fallen Alteraci aristocrats. Maleb sends trusted Alliance scouts to intercept their coded plans and kill their leaders. He works to break the Syndicate's hold before its plots can cripple Southshore's defenses.

faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb keeps civic order in Southshore, a coastal Alliance haven in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He oversees the town's civil affairs and protects it from threats within.

faq.q: Why is Maleb investigating the Syndicate?
faq.answer: Maleb took office after Southshore's previous magistrate was assassinated. His investigations point to Syndicate assassins hired by fallen Alteraci nobles, and he commissions Alliance adventurers to prevent another attempt on his life.

faq.q: Where can Magistrate Maleb be found?
faq.answer: You can find Magistrate Henry Maleb inside Southshore's town hall, in the southern Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What threats does Maleb face in Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: Maleb faces the threat of Forsaken expansion from the north and west, along with Syndicate killers stalking Southshore's outskirts and plotting against its leadership.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion in Hillsbrad, you can look to Magistrate Maleb as civic authority in a lawless borderland. He offers bounties on Syndicate cutthroats destabilizing Southshore.
As a rogue, you can see why Maleb is deeply concerned with stealth and assassination. He relies on keen-eyed operatives to outmaneuver the Syndicate's concealed killers.
